entries.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the FIRST reference image into a LOW-POLY STYLE REVISION of its same approved character and paired UI concept. Character name legible below Explorer and above enemy healthbar. Retain a simple Explorer tab/control layout, omit fabricated performance/source-code claims. This is a concept mockup, never a game screenshot. BRINE PUFFER. Preserve squat chunky teal armored puffer silhouette, oversized cream inflatable throat/belly, angry orange brow/eye, fan tail, broad angular fins used as feet. Only 5-7 large cream crown spines, 4-6 large teal armored planes; remove tiny scales/chips, fine wrinkles and glossy iris.
